notes.subject: שזפתו
notes.rationale: The verb שזף 'to scan/glimpse (as a piercing ray)' occurs only here in the Tanakh; rendered by plain 'ye' (see), the tanning/ray picture lost.

notes.subject: עיט / איה
notes.rationale: Two birds of prey named; versions split between 'vulture', 'falcon', 'kite', 'ravenous bird' — exact species uncertain.

notes.subject: sira min na
notes.rationale: The mine-path unknown even to the sharpest-eyed birds — hidden way, no eye has seen it.

translation: Sira min na, sɔrɔda si t'a dɔn, jakɔ ɲɛ t'a ye tɛ.
